Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task requirements by failing to correctly decode the reversed text and misunderstanding the logical sequence of the instructions. The input ".rewsna eht sa tfel drow eht fo etisoppo eht etirw ,ecnetnes siht dnatsrednu uoy fI" decodes to "If you understand this sentence, write the opposite of the word left as the answer." The Planner incorrectly identified the target word as "left" (the word in the decoded sentence) rather than "left" as the *first word of the original reversed string* (which is "answer"). Consequently, the Planner provided the opposite of "left" ("arrived" or "right" depending on interpretation) instead of the opposite of "answer" ("question"). This error matches the pattern of misinterpreting task requirements due to incorrect decoding and failing to validate the final answer against the actual task constraints.
